entries.36c07253c852559a: This segment groups the company, its subsidiaries and affiliates that fall under neither the domestic nor the overseas insurance business. The securities report explains that it mainly covers group company management and non-insurance businesses such as the asset management business and new businesses. Ordinary revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥471,478 million (of which ordinary revenue from external customers was ¥79,050 million), and the number of employees was 2,246. All 702 employees of the company itself, the insurance holding company, belong to this segment.
entries.4b471e8345de6be0: This is a [[term:segment|segment]] composed of subsidiaries that conduct insurance business in Japan, and includes The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, Dai-ichi Frontier Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Dai-ichi Neo Life Insurance Co., Ltd., and Dai-ichi Anipet Insurance Co., Ltd. The segment information in the securities report shows ordinary revenue instead of the revenue of general companies, and the order of businesses here is by ordinary revenue, from largest to smallest. Ordinary revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,669,631 million (of which ordinary revenue from external customers was ¥8,155,625 million), making it the largest category among the three reportable segments. Premium and other income was ¥5,108,737 million, and the number of employees was 48,222.
entries.5da099898e912716: This segment is composed of subsidiaries and affiliates that conduct insurance business overseas. It includes Protective Life Corporation in the United States, TAL Daiichi Life Australia Pty Ltd in Australia, Partners Group Holdings Limited in New Zealand, and companies in Vietnam, Cambodia and Myanmar. Ordinary revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,559,364 million (of which ordinary revenue from external customers was ¥3,523,786 million), premium and other income was ¥1,835,328 million, and the number of employees was 9,670.
entries.aff7780750b146d0: An insurance holding company that has Dai-ichi Life Insurance and others under its umbrella and underwrites life insurance in Japan, the United States, Australia and elsewhere.
